target.title: Add native Signal reply quotes
target.body:
## Summary

Signal auto-replies now preserve native Signal quote context when OpenClaw is responding to the inbound message that triggered the turn. The Signal plugin threads the inbound message timestamp, author, and body through reply delivery, sends quote metadata to native `signal-cli`/json-rpc, and maps the same quote fields to the Signal REST container send API. When quote metadata is missing, explicitly opted out, points at a different reply target, or is rejected by the backend, OpenClaw falls back to a normal Signal message instead of dropping the reply.

## What Changed

- Inbound Signal handling records the inbound timestamp as the current reply target and carries native quote context into reply delivery.
- Signal text and media auto-replies include `replyToId`, `replyToAuthor`, and `replyToBody` only when they match the triggering inbound message.
- `replyToCurrent: false`, mismatched explicit reply targets, `replyToMode: off`, and single-message `batched` mode suppress native quote metadata.
- `replyToMode: first` consumes native quote metadata only for the first normal implicit reply while preserving transient status/fallback/compaction notice behavior.
- Native sends retry without quote metadata when Signal rejects quote fields, while receipts preserve `replyToId` and record whether native quote send used `sent` or `fallback` status.
- Signal REST container mode translates quote metadata to `/v2/send` snake_case fields and strips `uuid:` prefixes from quote authors for the container API.
- Signal config now accepts `replyToMode` and direct/group `replyToModeByChatType` at channel and account scope, with account values taking precedence.
- Signal approval-reaction hint registration now works for structured approval payload delivery, including routed delivery results, without relying on temporary local setup.
- Signal docs describe native quote behavior, fallback, and the new reply-to config fields.

## Proof

Behavioral proof:

- Focused tests cover native quote send, fallback retry, receipt metadata, REST container quote fields, inbound context wiring, text replies, media replies, mismatched reply-target suppression, `replyToCurrent: false`, `replyToMode` chat/account precedence, single-use quote consumption, and config schema acceptance/rejection.
- Live Signal proof used a local Signal REST/json-rpc linked device. A non-self inbound event in the Testing realm group was captured, the feature-branch send path sent one quoted proof reply with `replyToId`, `replyToAuthor`, and `replyToBody`, Signal accepted the send with `deliveredMessageIdPresent=true`, and Jesse visually confirmed the reply appeared in Signal.

Manual proof gaps and follow-up risks:

- The live proof covers group native quote delivery. Basic Signal DM reply behavior is already working in this linked setup, but this closeout did not add a fresh manual DM native-quote proof.
- No further live Signal messages were sent after the confirmed Testing realm proof.
- Temporary local Signal REST/container config fixes used to complete live proof are not product proof and are not part of this PR.
- Signal group id normalization and Signal mention matching remain separate follow-up risks outside this PR.

Screenshots are not included because this is a backend channel transport change with no OpenClaw-rendered UI surface. The human-visible proof is the live Signal confirmation above.

## Verification

Reviewer-checkable behavior:

- `fnm exec --using 22.21.0 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/send.test.ts extensions/signal/src/client-container.test.ts extensions/signal/src/core.test.ts extensions/signal/src/monitor.tool-result.sends-tool-summaries-responseprefix.test.ts extensions/signal/src/monitor/event-handler.inbound-context.test.ts` passed: 5 files, 150 tests.
- `fnm exec --using 22.21.0 node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `fnm exec --using 22.21.0 node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD && git diff --check` passed before commit.
- Proof-pack net diff at `f32db0a2a25` found 19 changed files and no branch-only churn with no net diff.
- Native review retry at `f32db0a2a25` completed clean with no accepted/actionable findings after dependency-contract checks against `signal-cli` and `signal-cli-rest-api` quote fields.
- Earlier targeted Blacksmith Testbox changed gate `tbx_01kwaxm04x06337mak6sxmhe8v` passed `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed` on the then-current Signal diff; this branch has since had the local overlay committed and pushed.
